house_style: Soft painted gouache with fine colored-pencil grain, sophisticated music-room illustration for ages 11 to 14. assets.name: rehearsal-room
assets.prompt: An empty school band rehearsal room in dim evening light, pale painted brick walls, rows of empty black music stands and folding chairs at the back, a worn wooden floor with a few cables, a warm lamp glow in the left corner. Wide open foreground for four instrument stations. No instruments in this background.

assets.name: shaker
assets.prompt: One small hand-sized egg-shaped wooden percussion shaker resting on a tall worn four-legged wooden music stool. The shaker is one-quarter the width of the round stool seat, with subtle wood grain and a fine equatorial join. Believable four legs and sturdy crossbars, fully visible. Front three-quarter view, warm upper-left light, restrained amber highlights, cool dark undersides. Whole stool and shaker centered with margin, on flat pure green #00FF00 including the holes between legs. No ground plane, people, text or logos.
